newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Turkey's Erbakan arrives in Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Erbakan arrives in Nigeria.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan arrived in the Nigerian capital Abuja on Monday, airport officials said.
"He arrived at around 1410 (1310 GMT)," one official at the airport's protocol department said.

Erbakan was originally scheduled to arrive in Nigeria on Sunday for a two day visit, but Turkish embassy officials said his flight from North Africa was delayed because of bad weather in the Sahara desert.
The Islamist prime minister has visited Libya and Egypt on a tour which has provoked an outcry both inside Turkey and among its traditional western allies.
Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation, has been shunned by the West for human rights abuses and lack of democracy.
Officials said Erbakan would meet military ruler General Sani Abacha during his visit.
